prior_to_rotation: Review addiction rotation goals and MAT protocols on the resident website
Confirm clinic location, schedule, and supervising faculty before block start
Review DEA/MAT documentation expectations if prescribing buprenorphine or naltrexone
overview: Outpatient addiction psychiatry block — opioid, alcohol, and polysubstance use disorders with medication-assisted treatment, relapse prevention, harm reduction, and coordination with IOP/partial programs when indicated.
location: UH/VA addiction clinic sites per block assignment — confirm with program coordinator
schedule: Typically Monday–Friday outpatient sessions; may include IOP shadowing
Psychiatry Didactics Wednesdays; block-end debrief encouraged for PGY-2+
logistics: Document substance use history, withdrawal risk, and MAT consent clearly
Coordinate with social work, nursing, and primary care for continuity
Track PDMP and controlled-substance rules per site
debrief_prompts: MAT initiation or continuation — risk/benefit conversation you led
Relapse or overdose concern — how you adjusted the plan
Harm reduction or motivational interviewing moment that changed alliance
Systems navigation — IOP, residential, or primary care handoff
